groups.title: Presets & Mode
groups.blurb: What the server is tuned to do. One GPU runs one mode at a time.

fields.label: Speculative drafter
fields.desc: How the model drafts ahead to go faster. mtp = built-in head (safe default). dflash2 = block drafter (fastest for one user). off/none = no speculation.

fields.label: Context size
fields.desc: fast = 64k context, fastest. long = 150k context. huge = 240k context (needs KVarN; slower).

fields.label: KV-cache type (batch only)
fields.desc: Batch mode only. fp8 = default. kvarn = 4/2-bit cache for 262k context. int4pth = int4 per-token-head.

fields.label: Reuse shared prompt (prefix cache)
fields.desc: Keeps a document you already sent, so follow-up turns are ~20x faster. On for chat, off for unrelated one-shot prompts.

groups.title: Context & Capacity
groups.blurb: How much context and how many simultaneous requests.

fields.label: Max context (tokens)
fields.desc: Largest prompt+answer in tokens. 65536 for fast, 150000 for long.

fields.label: Max simultaneous requests
fields.desc: How many requests are admitted at once. 8 single-user, 64 batch.

fields.label: GPU memory to use (0–1)
fields.desc: Fraction of GPU memory reserved. 0.93 single, 0.95 batch. Don't raise past this.

fields.label: Verify block (dflash2)
fields.desc: Tokens verified per step with dflash2. 7 = normal. 15 = 'reproduce/quote' mode (4 slots, 56k context, much faster when the answer quotes the prompt).

fields.label: Draft depth (mtp)
fields.desc: How many tokens mtp drafts per step. 4 default (3 for long/huge). 5–6 are slower.

fields.label: Pin KV pool (bytes, advanced)
fields.desc: Pin the KV pool to an exact byte size. Leave empty to size from GPU_UTIL.

groups.title: Drafting & Speculation
groups.blurb: Fine controls for the drafting (advanced — defaults are good).

fields.label: Split-KV verify attention
fields.desc: faster verify step on CTX=fast. Leave on.

fields.label: Draft sampling
fields.desc: probabilistic = right for temperature > 0. greedy = same speed at T=0, ~15% slower at T>0.

fields.label: Draft from the prompt (lookup)
fields.desc: dflash2 only. Lets the drafter copy text straight from your prompt when the answer repeats it. Leave on.

fields.label: Use 40k draft vocabulary
fields.desc: Faster drafting. Set off if you mostly send Chinese or other text outside English/Danish/code.

groups.title: Performance & Quantization
groups.blurb: int8 speed tweaks (mostly for batch / prefill).

fields.label: int8 activations
fields.desc: int8 tensor-core GEMMs for faster prefill. (empty) = off (single default), int8 = on (batch default).

fields.label: Which layers go int8
fields.desc: mlp = default, gate_up = gentler, . = every layer (fastest, +3.7% perplexity, needs GPU_UTIL 0.95).

fields.label: int8 prefill attention
fields.desc: Companion to int8 activations for a few long prompts. Usually leave off.

fields.label: Tool / function calling
fields.desc: Lets clients call tools (tool_calls). Off and tool_choice:'auto' will 400.

fields.label: Tool-call parser
fields.desc: Must match the model's output format. qwen3_coder is correct for Qwen here.

fields.label: Reasoning effort (thinking level)
fields.desc: Server-level default thinking level for requests that do not set one themselves (a per-request reasoning_effort still wins). off = no thinking at all; low = brief; medium = balanced; xhigh = the model's built-in default (what blank means). Restart the server after saving.

fields.label: Keep vision tower (images)
fields.desc: On to accept images (costs ~0.86 GB). Off for text-only.

fields.label: Offload vision tower to RAM
fields.desc: With VISION on, keeps the tower in host RAM. Needed on 24 GB + dflash2.

fields.label: Per-request metrics
fields.desc: Adds timing fields to each response (what llama-swap dashboards read).

fields.label: Stream keep-alive (seconds)
fields.desc: Keep-alive interval so long streams survive a proxy timeout during a long prefill.

fields.label: Download fast variant model
fields.desc: On for the +15% faster variant at first boot. Off for a lighter setup.

fields.label: Warm up after boot
fields.desc: qwen-server.sh only: run a warm-up pass so the first real request is fast.

groups.title: Network & Identity
groups.blurb: Where the server listens and how it's secured.

fields.label: Port
fields.desc: The API port. Change only to avoid a conflict.

fields.label: Model path
fields.desc: Path to the model. Usually leave as-is.

fields.label: API key
fields.desc: REQUIRED before the port is reachable by anything but this machine — the server has no other auth. Use 'Generate' below.

fields.label: Hugging Face token
fields.desc: Your HF token for model downloads. Leave as-is if set.

fields.label: WSL2 pin memory
fields.desc: Keep on for Docker Desktop / WSL2, or the server aborts with a UVA error. No cost on native Linux.

groups.title: Advanced (expert)
groups.blurb: Power-user overrides. Extra args win over every other flag.

fields.label: Extra vLLM args (raw)
fields.desc: Raw vLLM flags appended last (so they override). E.g. --tensor-parallel-size 2. Leave empty unless you know why.

fields.label: Visible GPUs
fields.desc: Pin which GPU cards, e.g. 1,2. Leave empty for the default.

fields.label: GPU count handed to container
fields.desc: 1 = first GPU. 2 / all for multi-GPU tensor parallelism.

fields.label: OS / Display VRAM (MiB)
fields.desc: VRAM held by Windows (DWM, display buffers, WSL2 compositor). Typical: 400-600 MiB. Set 0 to exclude.

presets.name: A — Batch (many requests)
presets.desc: API backend / many concurrent. 64 slots, 150k context, int8 speed.

presets.name: B — Single (default)
presets.desc: One/few people chatting. 64k context, 8 slots, fastest default.

presets.name: C — Single + quote/reproduce
presets.desc: When answers quote the prompt (code edits, RAG, translation). 4 slots, 56k.

presets.name: E — Single, huge context
presets.desc: 200k+ context via KVarN. Slower past ~100k, for very long docs.
